title: Advanced ScoreBoard
description: the best score board plugin for your minecraft server !
body:
AdvancedScoreboard is the ultimate lightweight and highly customizable scoreboard plugin for Minecraft 1.21+, built for performance, flexibility, and modern server design. Whether you run a survival, SkyBlock, or RPG server, this plugin allows you to create stunning, real-time scoreboards that enhance the player experience without impacting performance.

With AdvancedScoreboard, you can easily display dynamic player information such as playtime, kills, deaths, online player counts, and much more. The plugin fully supports PlaceholderAPI, giving you access to hundreds of placeholders and allowing complete control over your scoreboard content. Every line is fully configurable, making it simple to design a scoreboard that perfectly matches your server’s style and branding.

Designed with optimization in mind, AdvancedScoreboard ensures a zero-lag experience, even on large servers. It also supports multiple scoreboards, enabling you to create different layouts for worlds, groups, or game modes. Whether you want a minimalistic display or a feature-rich interface, this plugin adapts to your needs.

Key features include real-time updates, advanced customization options, seamless PlaceholderAPI integration, and a clean configuration system that is easy to use for both beginners and advanced server owners.

AdvancedScoreboard is the perfect solution for any Minecraft server looking to deliver a clean, professional, and advanced scoreboard system while maintaining top-tier performance.
